card.name: Multiple myeloma drug dosing text
card.fires_on: Spots inside multiple myeloma dosing sections, at the space before a number, partway through names like lenalidomide, pomalidomide and Kyprolis, and in decimal doses of bortezomib.

modes.label: Space before a dose number
modes.description: A space or decimal point just before a cycle count or dose value in myeloma regimens.

modes.label: Inside myeloma drug names
modes.description: The middle of lenalidomide, pomalidomide or carfilzomib (Kyprolis) names.

card.plain: It lights up in dosing sections for myeloma drugs, such as bortezomib, lenalidomide and pomalidomide, mostly at spots just before or inside dose numbers and drug names.
